name: azure-lean-stack-skills
description: Azure Lean Stack — Claude Code skills for building Azure web apps that cost nothing when nobody's using them and scale up cleanly when they do. 17 composable skills, 56 documented gotchas, local→test→prod branch-per-environment CI/CD, managed identity wherever the host supports it, cost guardrails that are enforced (audit scripts + budget/stuck-warm alerts). Every pattern proven in a real production project. Complementary to Microsoft's azure-skills plugin.
tagline: Azure apps that cost nothing when nobody's using them.
